LAHORE: The Indus at Tarbela had an inflow of 20,700 cusecs and an outflow of 30,000 cusecs, while the Kabul at Nowshera recorded 22,500 cusecs. The Jhelum at Mangla saw inflows of 22,100 cusecs against outflows of 60,000 cusecs. The water level in Tarbela stood at 1,439.76 feet against a maximum conservation level of 1,550 feet, with live storage of 1.261 million acre-feet. Mangla stood at 1,103.70 feet against its maximum of 1,242 feet, with 0.680 MAF. Chashma was at 646.90 feet.
